about: Measured on gleam-lang/gleam with git, 12 Nov 2026. Sizes are lines in all .rs files of a shallow clone of each tag; test lines are files named tests.rs, *test*.rs or under tests/. Events are the dates of the commits named in `commit`.

events.what: First commit: "Innit, with the start of a tokenizer". The prototype is written in Erlang, with a leex tokenizer and a yecc parser.
"AST in Rust": the compiler restarts in Rust. Pretty printing and Erlang rendering follow within a day.
A hand written lexer and parser are hooked up; the generated LALRPOP grammar is removed three weeks later.
First JavaScript backend commits; released in v0.16.
The compiler is split into a pure core and a CLI that does the IO. A WebAssembly build follows a week later.
The language server starts, inside the compiler.
A call graph orders functions by use, so definitions can appear in any order.
Analysis becomes fault tolerant: keep going after an error, for better diagnostics and a better language server.
The JavaScript backend starts generating code from the decision trees.
The language server moves to its own crate.
Module metadata switches from Cap'n Proto to serde.
The Erlang backend learns to write Erlang abstract format directly; an arena based pretty printer, the formatter and the Erlang builders become separate crates over the following weeks.
